name: Ember
rules:
Warm, unhurried and editorial: a magazine page, not a dashboard.

- Rust #B23A1E is the brand: bands, primary buttons, solid badges. The third mode ("green" in vibe.json) is the rust band.
- Amber #F2B134 is the accent and gets ONE hit per shot: an underline, a highlight, a key number. Text on amber is black, never white.
- The glow (rust → orange → amber, half off-screen, drifting) is the only gradient allowed. Never behind small text.
- Type: IBM Plex Serif 700 for headlines, Plex Sans for everything read at small sizes, Plex Mono for numbers and code. Arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic; RTL mirrors the layout.
- Let headlines breathe: short lines, generous margins, one idea per shot.
- Motion is slow and settled: things arrive and rest. No bounce, no elastic easing.
- Never: a cool blue or violet accent; more than one accent colour in a shot; neon, lens flares, particle bursts.
